name: Discrete element method (DEM)
domain: 车辆—轨道与基础结构动力学
definition_zh: 通过离散颗粒或块体及其接触关系模拟力学行为的方法。
usage_overview: 在有砟轨道分析中，用于从颗粒尺度研究道床受力、运动与支承行为，以独立道砟颗粒及其接触关系表征道床，考察颗粒形状及轨枕—道砟相互作用，并由颗粒运动与接触计算宏观阻力。

complete_examples.text: Instead of the expensive full-scale experiments, an alter-native, a combination of discrete element method (DEM) and finite element method (FEM) to model the ballasted track system, is therefore developed to obtain sufficiently enough track properties to achieve statistical evaluation of uneven track parameters.
As it is well known, ballast particles can easily be simulated as sphere units in Particle Flow Code (PFC) using discrete element method (DEM).

In this section, the discrete element method (DEM) is utilized to simulate the ballast particle, and the e®ectiveness and reliability of this approach for studying the ballast granular material have been con ̄rmed in the work of Refs. 17, 18, 20, and 21.
In this section, the image-aided discrete element method (DEM) is introduced to simulate the railway ballasted track.
Finally, the reconstructed ballast surface mesh is imported into the discrete element method (DEM) software as rigid-block element (rigid body) template.
